SELECT p.product_line, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_amount_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

SELECT r.sales_region_name AS sales_region,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r
  ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name
ORDER BY r.sales_region_name;

SELECT c.customer_type,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_amount_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_customer c
  ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY c.customer_type;

SELECT dp.product_category, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_amount_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product dp ON f.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY dp.product_category
ORDER BY dp.product_category;

SELECT p.technology_route, SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS "人民币毛利"
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.technology_route;

SELECT c.customer_region, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_region
ORDER BY c.customer_region;

SELECT p.product_line, SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS sales_cost_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

SELECT r.sales_region_code,
       r.sales_region_name,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS gross_margin_rate
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_code, r.sales_region_name
ORDER BY r.sales_region_code;

SELECT p.product_line, COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS rmb_net_sales
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date d ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01';

SELECT p.product_line AS product_line,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS gross_profit_cny,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS gross_margin
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line;

SELECT p.product_line,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_amount_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p
  ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date d
  ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

SELECT
  r.sales_region_name,
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS "人民币毛利",
  SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS "毛利率"
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_date d
  ON f.completion_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region r
  ON f.sales_region_key = r.sales_region_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
GROUP BY r.sales_region_name;

SELECT p.product_line,
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS "人民币净销售额",
       SUM(f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS "人民币销售成本",
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) AS "人民币毛利",
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS "毛利率"
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY p.product_line
ORDER BY p.product_line;

SELECT c.customer_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS "已完成订单数",
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS "人民币净销售额",
       SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny - f.sales_cost_amount_cny) / NULLIF(SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny), 0) AS "毛利率"
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line f
JOIN mart_sales.dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_type;
